name: Trustcaptcha
author: trustcaptcha

sections.description:
GDPR-compliant reCAPTCHA alternative with bot score. Protect your website from bot attacks and spam with our invisible and GDPR-compliant reCAPTCHA alternative. Benefit from our multi-layered security concept with proof-of-work and intelligent bot score for reliable bot detection.

Supported Plugins:

  • BBPress New Topic
  • BBPress Reply
  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Forminator
  • Gravity Forms
  • Mailchimp for WordPress
  • Ninja Forms
  • Ninja Forms Multi Step
  • WordPress Comments
  • WordPress Login
  • WordPress Lost Password
  • WordPress Registration
  • WooCommerce Login
  • WooCommerce Registration
  • WooCommerce Checkout
  • WooCommerce Lost Password
  • WP Forms

Short Description

GDPR-compliant reCAPTCHA alternative with bot score.

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses Trustcaptcha, a third-party service, to provide CAPTCHA verification for bot protection. By using this plugin, requests are sent to the Trustcaptcha servers to verify CAPTCHA challenges. This requires sharing certain data (e.g., the user’s IP address and CAPTCHA responses) with Trustcaptcha.

Service URL: Trustcaptcha
Terms of Service: Trustcaptcha Terms and Conditions
Privacy Policy: Trustcaptcha Privacy Policy

Trustcaptcha is GDPR compliant and is hosted on servers within the EU. Please make sure that the use of this third-party service complies with your local regulations. This plugin relies on Trustcaptcha for CAPTCHA verification, and using the service involves data transmission to Trustcaptcha’s servers.

Need help?

You have a question, need help or a plugin is not yet listed? Please contact our support team: Contact us
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin browser or by uploading the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/trustcaptcha directory.
  2. Create a Trustcaptcha account at Trustcaptcha and create a new captcha.
  3. Obtain your Captcha Credentials (site-key and secret-key, which can be found here) and enter them in the Trustcaptcha settings in WordPress (Settings -> Trustcaptcha).
  4. Activate Trustcaptcha for all desired plugins.
  5. Insert Trustcaptcha in all desired forms, if Trustcaptcha does not do this automatically.
